column2: to provide for the establishment of an aesthetic and research centre called
the “Amaradeva Aesthetic and Research Centre” in gratitude of the legendary
music  icon  in  Sri  Lanka,  late  Pandith  Wannakuwattawaduge  Don
Amaradeva; to  specify  its  objects  and powers and to provide for the
matters connected therewith or incidental thereto
